title: International Literature Festival Berlin 2026 - Quick Summary
items: **The main International Literature Festival Berlin programme runs 3 to 12 September 2026.** The separate Young Program runs 6 to 16 September.
**Buy one literary event you care about, then let its venue shape the day.** Do not build a citywide programme sprint from a festival calendar.
Check the exact event page for the language, format, venue, start time and ticket conditions. An international author does not automatically mean an English-language event.
Humboldt Forum suits a historic-centre day; Berliner Philharmonie fits Kulturforum; Haus der Berliner Festspiele fits a west-Berlin plan.
Leave a real travel buffer before readings and panels. One fixed event per evening is usually the better plan.
